page.layout: One printed page: ornamental band at top, then a line in Arabic, then the title in roman and italic capitals with a band below. Below the title rule, a signature "B" at the left, then faint lines of text too indistinct to read. Page number at top right corner. No margin notes.
page.notes: The Arabic line is set in Arabic script; its first word is uncertain (possibly ذكر), so it is marked as read from the scan only. The ornamental bands are decorative and not transcribed as text. The lines below the signature "B" are very faint and mostly show-through or unreadable, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The page number is a small roman "I".
